set.body: Inventory local/tracking/live remote revisions, all refs, worktrees and retained clones, stashes and dangling objects; trace unfinished Mote work to existing code and receipts; preserve at-risk local material and produce a reviewable restart report with an ordered 1.0 queue. Acceptance: durable inventory with exact identities, salvage dispositions, verification limits, and a simple one-writer/optional-reviewer workflow. This is recovery and assessment, not blanket ticket closure, code landing, cleanup or publication.
set.title: Audit and preserve unfinished work; record the October workflow restart
